name: Forsaking
overview: The concept of forsaking in Scripture emphasizes both God's faithfulness to His people and the cost of discipleship. God promises never to forsake His followers, as seen in Joshua 1:5, assuring His continual presence and support. Conversely, believers are called to forsake all worldly possessions and allegiances to truly follow Christ, highlighted in Luke 14:33. Additionally, Hebrews 10:25 instructs Christians not to forsake gathering together for mutual encouragement, underscoring the importance of community in the faith. These verses collectively reveal forsaking as a divine promise of steadfastness and a call to wholehearted commitment and fellowship.
